Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(hooks\): Add contextual "ways" system for just-in-time guidance

Implements a lightweight RAG-like system that injects relevant guidance
based on keywords and tool usage. Ways load once per session when triggered.

- 18 built-in ways: adr, api, commits, config, debugging, deps, errors,
  github, knowledge, migrations, patches, performance, quality, release,
  security, subagents, testing, tracking
- Frontmatter-based triggers \(keywords, files, commands patterns\)
- Project-local ways support \($PROJECT/.claude/ways/\)
- Auto-initialization with template for new projects
- Session-scoped state via /tmp markers
- PostToolUse additionalContext for Claude visibility
EOF
\)")

EOF
\)")
